name: aippocampus
description: Source-backed continuity for Codex agents: find old cues, reopen local source, and continue honestly.

interface.shortDescription: Recover source-backed conversation continuity from old cues.
interface.longDescription: AIppocampus helps a Codex agent reach one first source-backed recall: old cue -> local source hit or reopenable route -> boundary -> next action. It keeps privacy explicit, treats summaries and scents as navigation, and does not pretend the base model has innate memory. Plugin install, hooks, and optional external-model routes are separate explicit steps after the first receipt works.
defaultPrompt: Find one source-backed AIppocampus recall for this old cue.
Reopen the source trail behind this AIppocampus route.
Check AIppocampus readiness before continuing this thread.
